A couple of quick questions so I diagnose the right thing:

1. Where did you add the Stop hook — which settings file (user `~/.claude/settings.json`, project `.claude/settings.json`, or `.claude/settings.local.json`)? None of those currently contain a `hooks` key at all in this environment.
2. What's the handler — a script path/command? On Windows, a common silent-failure cause is a relative path or missing `"shell": "powershell"`, or using bare `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` instead of `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}`/`$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` (bare form resolves to `$null`).
3. What did you expect to happen when it fires, and what actually happens (nothing at all, error notice, wrong behavior)?

If you paste the hook config you added, I can check it directly against the Stop event's contract (command/http/mcp_tool/prompt/agent handlers, exit-0 JSON with `hookSpecificOutput` to block continuation, exit 2 as the blunt fallback) and the known Windows pitfalls.
